coverage.text: The S2 audio-only compressions_active track missed continuous manual chest compressions visibly performed on the mannequin from 80.0s to 229.0s and from 235.0s to 365.0s, and instead emitted three false-positive snippets (271.1-273.2s, 366.9-371.2s during ROSC celebration, and 432.7-435.7s during end-of-simulation applause).

All 13 device_audio hits (defib_charge_aborted and defibrillation_shock between 18.7s and 451.5s) are false positives triggered by periodic simulation monitor alarm chimes and room acoustics; the patient remained in PEA prior to ROSC and the defibrillator was never touched, charged, or discharged.
0.0-61.0s: Facilitator in yellow vest stands in front of the bed reading the clinical scenario stem; patient chest is partially occluded by the facilitator until 61.0s.

61.0-455.8s: Full unobstructed view of the mannequin on the stretcher and clear room audio; the wall monitors are off and the Zoll monitor on the left cart is angled slightly away with low screen contrast, though heart rate and rhythm are explicitly verbalized by the facilitator.
